saw_lines: Buyers of screws know the exact size they need, and they reorder the same one when a job repeats.
So the sale is won when the ad shows the size and thread right away, before a buyer scrolls to a competitor.
Your 6 of 13 copy ads open on the same line, so buyers keep meeting it. Write three new openers from your range and test each against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 6 of your 13 copy ads open on “über 50.000 artikel im shop”, so buyers keep meeting the same first line. Write three new openers from your own range, such as farm repair bolts, and test each one against it.
One exact copy runs in 5 of your 13 copy ads, so the same words reach the same buyers over and over. Keep that copy as the body, but change the opening line and the creative in each ad.

None of your 23 live ads shows a proof number, so a first time buyer has no reason to trust the range. Collect one real figure, like your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.
7 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product the ad shows, so they search again. Point each of those ads to the product or collection it shows, such as the wood screw kits.
